data.title: MRTA to review Hat Yai's monorail
data.description: The Mass Rapid Transit Authority of Thailand (MRTA) plans to review Hat Yai's monorail project next year, aiming to update a decade-old study to reflect new conditions and lessons from the 2025 major floods.

data.title: PCD probes Rangsit canal after fish deaths
data.description: The Pollution Control Department (PCD) is investigating pollution in Rangsit canal in Pathum Thani after mass fish deaths and reports of dark, foul-smelling water.

data.title: Economic challenges need global action
data.description: Thailand has called for stronger international cooperation to help economies navigate geopolitical tensions, rising energy costs and technological disruption, arguing that global partnerships must turn investment and innovation into tangible benefits for people and businesses.

data.title: Govt fleshes out energy transition plans
data.description: Thailand plans to accelerate its green transition by reducing energy import dependence, attracting private investment and strengthening climate resilience while creating jobs.

data.title: Rayong sweep uncovers 'unlicensed' karaoke spots
data.description: A raid on four karaoke venues in Rayong found that all were operating without entertainment licences, while two were suspected of concealing prostitution, the Interior Ministry said on Saturday.

data.title: Police trace 'cannabis' sweets
data.description: Police are tracing the source of online-purchased sweets suspected of containing cannabis after three family members, including a two-year-old boy, became seriously ill.

data.title: Pension reform needs good governance
data.description: Pension reforms should protect retirement savings while allowing funds to invest in domestic economies, with sound governance and returns for members remaining the top priorities, forum speakers said.

data.title: IMF helps members tackle 'modern risks'
data.description: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) is updating its Financial Sector Assessment Program (FSAP) to help member countries protect their financial systems against modern threats, including AI, cyberattacks, rising public debt and geopolitical tensions.

data.title: Ministry eyes illegal dumping
data.description: The Industry Ministry is pushing to establish dedicated recycling industrial estates to manage growing volumes of solar panel and electric vehicle (EV) battery waste, while tightening controls on hazardous industrial waste disposal.

data.title: Albanian capital sees fifth straight day of violent clashes
data.description: TIRANA (ALBANIA) - Albania's capital saw violent clashes for a fifth straight day on Saturday as police fired rubber bullets on protesters demanding the resignation of Prime Minister Edi Rama, who pledged to listen to their concerns.

data.title: Haaland stars in Man City win, Liverpool beat Brentford
data.description: LONDON - Erling Haaland starred with a double as Premier League leaders Manchester City beat Ipswich 3-2, while Liverpool came from behind to seal a 2-1 win at Brentford on Saturday.

data.title: Four more Ebola cases detected in Kenya, bringing total to seven
data.description: NAIROBI - Kenya has confirmed four new Ebola cases, the health ministry said Saturday, including another relative of the first victim and three healthcare workers who treated him.

data.title: Pope Leo leaves hospital five days after cancer surgery
data.description: VATICAN CITY - Pope Leo XIV left hospital on Saturday to return to the Vatican, five days after his lung cancer surgery.

data.title: Fifth day of violent clashes in Albanian capital
data.description: TIRANA - Albania’s capital saw clashes for a fifth straight day Saturday as protesters demanded the resignation of Prime Minister Edi Rama, who pledged to listen to their criticism.

data.title: Indian ‘cockroach’ party founder freed from detention
data.description: NEW DELHI - Cockroach Janata Party founder Abhijeet Dipke was released from detention on Saturday, a day after his arrest during a police crackdown on protests against the election authority.

data.title: Central Bankers Urge 'Collaboration' as AI Reshapes Inflation, Jobs and Financial Stability
data.description: G30 panel in Bangkok calls for stronger model testing, classic financial safeguards and early anti-fraud design as AI raises systemic risks

data.title: Police officer and insurgent killed in Narathiwat clash
data.description: One police officer was killed and two paramilitary ranger volunteers injured in a clash with suspected insurgents in Sri Sakhon district of Narathiwat on Saturday. One suspected insurgent was also killed.

data.title: Competing ‘Nene Royal’ trademark bids emerge
data.description: Confusion has arisen over trademark applications for the stage name of Thai teen rocker Nene Royal, after a woman whose connection to the America’s Got Talent winner is unclear filed to register the name and logo — even before the artist’s managing company.

data.title: BoT Governor Calls for Global Guardrails as AI and Fraud Reshape Finance
data.description: Governor Vitai Ratanakorn tells G30 seminar in Bangkok that AI and instant payments widen access but let fraud spread faster, urging cross-border action

data.title: France faces day of cost-of-living protests
data.description: PARIS - French authorities detained dozens on Saturday at the start of nationwide protests against the cost of living, in what is likely to be a key indicator of the social climate heading toward elections to replace President Emmanuel Macron.

data.title: Pope returning to Vatican after cancer surgery
data.description: VATICAN CITY - Pope Leo XIV was preparing on Saturday to leave the Rome hospital where he has been recovering from lung cancer surgery, the Vatican said, after doctors deemed him “fit for discharge”.

data.title: Haze triggers highest-level alert in parts of Southeast Asia
data.description: SINGAPORE - Fires in Indonesia that have sent toxic smoke disrupting daily life across Southeast Asia has triggered the highest-level alert by the regional bloc’s meteorological monitor.

data.title: Tokyo hosts second round of US-Myanmar talks
data.description: TOKYO - Representatives of the United States and Myanmar’s military-backed government held talks in Tokyo last week, people familiar with ​the matter said, their second meeting in a month as Washington steps up re-engagement with the generals it ‌shunned after their 2021 coup.

data.title: ONE Championship: Johan Ghazali open to Ondash rematch after settling Paez score
data.description: Johan Ghazali has left the door open to another fight with Ramadan Ondash in ONE Championship after avenging his defeat by Diego Paez – while reviving his complaint about the Lebanese fighter’s mouthguard.

data.title: ONE Championship: Rukiya Anpo says Samurai 4 fight is off after ninth failed hydration test
data.description: Rukiya Anpo says his fight against Bogdan Shumarov is off ONE Samurai 4 after a ninth failed hydration test on Saturday morning, leaving the Tokyo event without two of its highest-profile kickboxing bouts.

data.title: ONE Championship: Marat Grigorian into final after Luo Chao’s 9.4lb miss – ‘he just didn’t care’
data.description: Marat Grigorian has advanced to the ONE Samurai featherweight kickboxing tournament final after Luo Chao’s extraordinary 9.4lb weight miss, accusing his opponent of failing to take the cut seriously.

data.title: Trump waives key Russia-related sanctions and tariffs
data.description: WASHINGTON - President Donald Trump has waived key Russia-related US sanctions and tariffs days before they were to take effect under a law he signed last month, including duties on the country’s goods and penalties for buying its oil and gas.

data.title: Questions mount over gambling site and MP’s husband
data.description: Former Democrat MP Sirichok Sopha is demanding a deeper investigation into the blocking of the crypto gambling website Shuffle.com and the role played in the business by the husband of Bhumjaithai MP Suchada Zhang Thaensap.

data.title: IMF chief to take King Bhumibol’s teachings to Washington after Bangkok meetings
data.description: IMF chief Kristalina Georgieva praises Thailand’s progress over 35 years and hospitality as the country hosts the 2026 IMF–World Bank meetings

data.title: Chinese fugitive ‘oversaw mule accounts worth B2.5 billion’
data.description: Thai police have arrested a Chinese fugitive in Bangkok for allegedly managing mule accounts that circulated over 500 million yuan and arranging visas for members of transnational criminal gangs.

data.title: Minister apologises over e-harvester price blunder
data.description: Agriculture and Cooperatives Minister Suriya Juangroongruangkit has apologised for mistakenly quoting a price of 16 million baht each for electric rice harvesters, insisting the ministry has no plans to buy the machines.

data.title: Academic asks why BMA overlooked flood projects
data.description: A Kasetsart University academic has questioned why Bangkok allocated more than 34 billion baht to flood prevention over two years while omitting six major eastern water-retention projects from its action plans.
